reviewType: independent read-only source review; reviewer authored no implementation or tests; only this review artifact is written

findings.title: Preserve the real legacy transport error envelope
findings.problem: A stale old product row targeting an absent product initially received HTTP200/body.status404 from NotFoundException; PHP del throws AdminException400. The real old plugins/request/index.js returns only status200, rejects400/400011/400012, and resolves undefined for status404. Its ProductList delete handler then reads res.msg from undefined. Initial canonical HttpApiException409/503 likewise enters the old HTTP-error interceptor which logs but returns undefined.
findings.reproduction: Call the genuine old tableDelApi({url:product/product/998,method:DELETE,ids:""}) through the genuine old plugins/request transport; the initial source resolves undefined rather than rejecting with msg 商品数据不存在. Under a product/authority table conflict the initial409 path has the same undefined outcome.
findings.testGap: Initial old-client test compiled tableDelApi but replaced the entire old transport with a new reject-all interceptor, so it could not detect the genuine interceptor behavior.
findings.status: resolved by root; corrected implementation and genuine old transport fixture independently read back; execution remains root validation responsibility
findings.agreedCorrection: Missing product retains status400. Canonical legacy wire without expected_is_del maps definite409/503 failures to HTTP200/status400; guarded modern wire retains strict409/503. Unknown failures retain unknown semantics. Compile the genuine old request module with host dependencies stubbed instead of replacing its interceptors.

resolutionReadback.controller: Only canonical mode toggle with absent expected_is_del catches definite HttpApiException409/503 and returns jsonFail HTTP200/status400. Explicit expected state, aliases and unknown failures retain their existing strict/unknown behavior. The catch surrounds service.change; postcommit dispatch errors are already swallowed after durable success.
resolutionReadback.tests: The fixture now bundles actual old plugins/request/index.js plus common.js.tableDelApi, stubs only store/util/setting/view-design hosts and keeps source interceptors. The adapter explicitly throws AxiosError for actual App non2xx, matching native adapter behavior. New trigger cases compare old400 rejection and modernHTTP409/503, while missing parent asserts400; not executed by reviewer.

checkedSemantics.lockOrder: Authority barriers precede unlocked complete family snapshot, ascending bargain exclusive fences and product try-fences. Four physical SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE NOWAIT table barriers precede exact family re-read and row readsets; this avoids holding product/cart barriers while awaiting a bargain admission shared holder. checkedSemantics.durability: Dedicated product.recycle.effects audit/intent is committed with business writes. Persistent owner/product/run markers and Web Locks fence pending or uncertain requests; later same-session catalog read plus manual acknowledgment is required before a new decision. Dialog closes on identity/route replacement, ignores late scoped results, exposes restore visibility/child propagation/cart invalidation, and works in recycle list type6.
